recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. FHIR-11072 does not require restoring the obsolete DosageInstruction name or changing current medication resource definitions; revisit only if the work group changes the later DosageDetails model.
issue_request: FHIR-11072 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for DSTU2 asking to harmonize MedicationPrescription/MedicationOrder dosageInstruction with MedicationDispense.dosageInstruction. Its accepted resolution directed creation of a new DosageInstruction type for MedicationOrder, MedicationDispense, and MedicationStatement.
initial_application: Historical commit 1d00edee4413c641918bdf96071c2407902bc4c3 explicitly cited #11072, added the DosageInstruction datatype, and updated the medication resource sources. Commit 6a4b0d916ec0983d3c0e8a2d28366e99dc12fc76 later implemented FHIR-12840 by renaming DosageInstruction to Dosage.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini build scope lists Dosage and DosageDetails as active datatypes and MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement as active resources. MedicationOrder/MedicationPrescription and the old DosageInstruction name are retained only in removed-resource/change-map history. Later R6 dosage work represented in current source introduces DosageDetails, which preserves the shared datatype model through a newer structure.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active definitions for MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction, MedicationDispense.dosageInstruction, and MedicationStatement.dosage are all 0..1 DosageDetails, and DosageDetails carries renderedInstruction plus simple or structured Dosage content.
